_about: Seeking Jesus of Nazareth artwork register (handoff 1.0, 2026-10-29). The sjArt(id) macro renders an item only when its status is APPROVED_DEPLOY. Every other status renders nothing. scripts/sjn-verify-artwork.js fails the build if an approved item's files are missing or the wrong size, if any file in srcDir is not claimed by an approved item, or if a pending, candidate, storyboard or reference image appears anywhere under src/assets. Status changes only on Aaron's recorded approval. decision records his placement rulings of 2026-10-29; the final package of 2026-10-29 approved thirteen pieces (SJ-01–03, SJ-05–12, SJ-14, SJ-15) and removed SJ-04, SJ-13 and SJ-16 from scope. groups holds indivisible collections: sjArtGroup(groupId) renders a group only when every member is APPROVED_DEPLOY, sjArt() never renders a member on its own, and the build refuses a group that is only partly approved (ruled 2026-10-29).

categories-panel.title: The four categories, in pictures
categories-panel.ariaLabel: Four paintings, one for each category: shared, shared but differently understood, different, and addition
categories-panel.ruling: Aaron, 2026-10-29: one indivisible collection. None appears in production until all four are approved. All four are 3:2.
